verification.unit: 900 pass, zero fail across 137 files; subsequent outline-only CSS passes a fresh build and compiled tests
verification.outline: 25 Chromium and 24 Firefox/WebKit source and compiled checks include >=3:1 selected outline; light/dark and system forced-color checks pass separately

changes: Segmented Control reuses the extracted single-selection owner and RadioNavigation; real Group owns presentation and the private indicator owns motion. Items expose value/disabled plus semantic inputs, with no second form owner or checked state.
Switch replaces Toggle, retains the 28x14/36x20/40x24 track tiers, adopts canonical native forms and uses a Lit Motion scalar spring for its thumb.
All segmented Switch/Switch Control consumers move to the new family, including Code Block. Old Toggle and Switch Control classes/definitions/exports/styles/docs are removed.
A parent reset previously erased a nested Group host border/padding. House elements identify their own reset boundary and the zero-specificity parent reset leaves their host styles intact.
Native barred controls can retain valueMissing=true with an empty validationMessage. nativeValidation now excludes barred controls and re-evaluates when participation resumes.

The standard analyzer treated this.input.className and this.input.name assignments as host fields/defaults. Source facts now remove nested-assignment phantom fields and preserve actual initialized host defaults.
The light selected fill measures 1.192:1 against white. A one-pixel gray-800 inner outline retains the requested gray fill and provides a three-to-one selected-state boundary.
limits: Tabs and Theme Switcher remain in M10.
Actual Toolbar collection integration remains M14, managed-form adapter completion M11/M22, actual speech output and complete library/package appearance acceptance M26.
Local review and native oracles are used while independent review workers are unavailable.
